mapper.select: select count(*) from post p where 1 = 1
select coalesce(sum(p.view_count), 0) from post p where 1 = 1
select count(*) from post_like l join post p on p.id = l.post_id where 1 = 1
select count(*) from comment c join post p on p.id = c.post_id where c.status = 'VISIBLE'

select date_format(p.happened_at, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as posts, coalesce(sum(p.view_count), 0) as views from post p where 1 = 1
group by date_format(p.happened_at, '%Y-%m') order by month

select p.mood as name, count(*) as count from post p where p.mood is not null and p.mood != '' and p.mood != 'none'
group by p.mood order by count desc, name
